d: S5735-S24PN4XE-V2 (24*10/100/1000/2.5GBASE-T ports(PoE+), 4*10GE SFP+ ports, 2*12GE stack ports, without power module)

specs.label: Layer 2 features
specs.value: VLAN, Voice VLAN, STP, RSTP, MSTP, Port Security, MAC address filtering, Link Aggregation (LACP - IEEE 802.3ad), Port mirroring (SPAN), IGMP Snooping

specs.label: Layer 3 features
specs.value: Static routing, RIP, OSPF, EIGRP, Inter-VLAN routing, Policy-based routing (PBR), IPv4 / IPv6 Dual Stack, BGP

specs.label: Security features
specs.value: 802.1X authentication, MAC authentication bypass, Access Control Lists (ACLs), Secure Boot & Trust Anchor Module (TAM), MACsec (128/256-bit encryption), SSH

specs.label: Performance & reliability
specs.value: Redundant, hot-swappable power supplies, Non-blocking architecture, Enterprise-grade MTBF

specs.label: Multicast
specs.value: IGMP v1, IGMP v2, IGMP v3, IGMP Snooping, PIM Sparse Mode (PIM-SM), Source-Specific Multicast (SSM)

specs.label: QoS (Quality of service)
specs.value: Hardware-based QoS at wire speed, Traffic classification & marking (CoS / DSCP), Priority queuing for voice & video, Policing, shaping, CIR, Up to 8 egress queues per port, Queue Management, DSCP Support

specs.label: Security
specs.value: IEEE 802.1X Port-based Authentication, MAC Authentication Bypass (MAB), ACLs (IPv4 / IPv6 / MAC), DHCP Snooping, Secure Boot & Trust Anchor, Web Authentication (WebAuth)
